title: Statistical, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Missing Covariates: An Empirical Evaluation with Applications to Alzheimer's Disease Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.25219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Missing data are common in biomedical research, particularly when biomarkers are costly or require invasive procedures to obtain, such as cerebrospinal fluid measures in Alzheimer's disease. Although a wide range of missing data methods exists, from traditional statistical approaches to modern machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, their comparative performance under different missingness mechanisms remains insufficiently understood. In this study, we provide an empirical evaluation of eight methods for handling missing covariates, including complete-case analysis, multiple imputation, ML-based techniques, and DL frameworks such as multilayer perceptrons, variational autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks. We summarize their conceptual foundations, practical implementation considerations, strengths, and limitations. translated_title: 处理缺失协变量的统计学、机器学习与深度学习方法：在阿尔茨海默病研究中的实证评估
translated_abstract: 缺失数据在生物医学研究中十分常见，尤其是当生物标志物成本高昂或需要侵入性操作才能获取时，例如阿尔茨海默病研究中的脑脊液指标。尽管目前存在从传统统计方法到现代机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）算法的多种缺失数据处理方法，但它们在不同缺失机制下的比较性能仍缺乏充分了解。在本研究中，我们对八种处理缺失协变量的方法进行了实证评估，包括完整病例分析、多重插补、基于机器学习的技术，以及多层感知机、变分自编码器和生成对抗网络等深度学习框架。我们总结了这些方法的概念基础、实际应用考量、优势与局限性。通过大量的模拟实验，我们评估了各方法的估计偏差、效率、标准误准确性等性能表现。
tldr: 本研究对八种处理缺失协变量的统计、机器学习和深度学习方法进行了系统性实证评估，在阿尔茨海默病研究背景下比较了它们在不同缺失机制下的表现。
en_tdlr: This study provides a systematic empirical evaluation of eight statistical, machine learning, and deep learning methods for handling missing covariates, comparing their performance under different missingness mechanisms with applications to Alzheimer's disease research.
